annotations.title: The BMI limit US fertility clinics state for IVF

description: The highest BMI US fertility clinics say on their own websites they accept for IVF or egg retrieval, each quoted with its page and the date read, with ASRM's position that no society-wide cutoff is justified and what the Wegovy and Zepbound labels say about stopping before pregnancy.
name: ivf_bmi_limits
